title: After every research call fails (Tier B 401, error steps on the stream), the copilot still replies 'Built you a brief on Infosys - it's at the top of the cockpit' though no brief was published; nothing in the runtime checks a brief claim against a publish
repro: vy.py invoke copilot 'Research Infosys for me: what drove its latest quarterly results? Give me a brief with sources.' --port 52152 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b --tier tier_b --header X-Vysted-Openrouter-Key=<fake sk-or-v1 canary>. Stream: research(depth deep) -> error step 'OpenRouter rejected the request', research(depth quick) -> same error step, no publish_brief/brief event, done. Answer text: 'Sorry about this error ... {"name": "research", ...}Built you a brief on Infosys - it's at the top of the cockpit; click any ticker to dig in.' The sentence is the example line in sidecar/agents/copilot.json systemPrompt ('After researching, reply in ONE or TWO sentences that POINT to the brief - e.g. Built you a brief on NVDA ...'), which the prompt gives with no failure branch. Model-driven (8B), but the false claim reaches the user unchecked.
